prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: compositional option three for the approved Cathode Gauze visual system of the native iOS Last Train app
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity portrait iPhone app screen that explores an ISLAND RELAY composition while keeping the Cathode Gauze identity completely fixed.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed 393x852-style app screen only, no phone frame and no marketing poster.
Exact visible content: "LAST TRAIN", "FAST TRAIN", "Upminster", "EAST", "23:47", "Shoeburyness", "22:58", "23:18", "23:32", "FIRST BACK", "05:12", "Direct services only".
Product task: reveal the final direct train within two seconds, with earlier departures and first train back subordinate. No durations. No +1 or calendar-next-day labels.
Fixed visual world: deep ink-blue black plane, fine bronze anode gauze, ghosted cathode numerals, bone-white text, warm cathode orange for ordinary active information, #FF304C reserved only for the last train. One condensed numeral-led display voice; crisp native body text. No rounded glass cards, no dashboard tiles, no bottom tab bar, no decorative illustration.
Composition variation: make the Dynamic Island the visual origin of a thin bronze-orange relay beam. The beam drops from the safe-area pill into a compact Upminster / EAST scope line, then activates one enormous red 23:47 centered in the middle of the screen with Shoeburyness. Behind it, a full-field stack of faint ghost times creates depth without reducing legibility. Beneath the focal event, arrange 22:58, 23:18, and 23:32 in one compact horizontal chronology strip with fixed cells; FIRST BACK 05:12 is a separate quiet terminal line at the bottom. LAST TRAIN / FAST TRAIN is a minimal top-edge text switch that does not compete with the Island relay.
Interaction implication: selecting a Fast Train should visibly send the chosen numeral upward along the beam into the Dynamic Island; on return it settles as the active struck-forward state.
Constraints: production-grade native iOS operating screen; immediately scannable; exact copy readable; red nowhere except the 23:47 last-train event; no generic cards, fake logos, watermark, phone hardware, maps, ticketing, advertising, or excessive glow.
